name: gutpopper-game-factory
description: AI game-production desktop app and private phone remote for the Small Games Prototype Lab.
author: Gutpopper Games

scripts.check: node --check server.js && node --check electron/main.cjs && node --check electron/preload.cjs && node --check public/app.js && node --check public/sw.js && node --check scripts/install-playwright.cjs
scripts.package:win: npm run check && npm run prepare:chromium && electron-forge package --platform=win32 --arch=x64
scripts.make:win: npm run check && npm run prepare:chromium && electron-forge make --platform=win32 --arch=x64
